notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, own tab. robots.txt read in-tab: Shopify storefront header states public product/collection HTML is crawlable; no Claude/ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai directive at all, no full-site disallow. Cookie banner dismissed with 'ONLY THE NECESSARY COOKIES'. Requests paced at ~1 per 4-5s; no 403 / Cloudflare challenge / rate-limit was hit at any point (the prior Home-Decor pass's 429 problem did not reappear via a real browser session). SITE HAS BEEN REDESIGNED since that pass: the perfion facet URLs (?filter.p.m.perfion.category=) are superseded by a real collection hierarchy encoded in the handle prefix (furniture > furniture-seating > furniture-seating-sofas). TREE: union of the mega-menu (11 top-level collections: News, Tableware, Kitchen, Candles, Home decor, Seasonal decor, Textiles, Lighting, Furniture, Outdoor living, Most Popular), the Furniture collection page's own sub-category chip strip, and each sub-collection page's chip strip. Only Furniture and Outdoor living carry furniture. QTY METHOD: Rule 1 throughout - every qty is the collection page's own server-rendered 'N products' header. Verified against the live rendered DOM for furniture-storage-and-shelves-wardrobe ('21 products', breadcrumb/title 'Wardrobe', canonical matches) to prove the fetched-HTML header is the same element the browser paints. CROSS-CHECK: /collections/<h>/products.json is disabled on this store (200 with 0 products), so 12 of the 18 nodes were additionally full-enumerated by paging ?page=N to the empty page and de-duping the numeric product handle - furniture 146=146, seating 69=69, tables 47=47, storage-and-shelves 26=26, sofas 52=52, chairs-and-stools 21=21, poufs 13=13, wardrobe 21=21, coat-racks 12=12, modular-shelving 11=11, wall-shelves 2=2, outdoor-living 33=33. Every header matched enumeration exactly; no inflation. The six small leaves (Armchairs 13, Benches 1, Side Tables 27, Dining Tables 2, Consoles 1, Desks 1) are header-only per Rule 1. SITE QUIRK - CHILDREN ARE NOT PARTITIONS OF THEIR PARENT: sub-collections here are curated and overlap each other and reach outside the parent. Seating 69 but its five children sum to 100 (Armchairs 13 is entirely contained in Chairs & Stools 21; Poufs 13 partly sits inside Sofas 52, which is the Wind/Lagoon/Bay modular sofa system incl. corner modules, chaise modules and Wind Legs). Tables 47 but its four children sum to 31 - the other 16 are tables the site simply did not file into a child (Miro/Sonja/Urna/Agari/Elaine/Tilde/Brook/Fiber/Eden Garden Table, Rillo Podium). Per Rule 2 the parents are grouping rows, so those 16 table SKUs are not represented by any leaf row; flagged here rather than papered over by recording the parent as a leaf. Do NOT sum leaves for this company. EXCLUSIONS, all decided on product evidence not on the facet name: 'Storage & Shelves' (26) was enumerated and is entirely baskets, boxes and a magazine holder (Gaby/Annika/Lola/Will/Emmy/Safi/Sabbie/Lykke Basket, Tenna/Cecelia/Stacie Box, Maggie Magazine holder) plus the 2 Tenna Shelf items - standalone storage goods, excluded, so it is a grouping row only. 'Wardrobe' (21) is NOT wardrobes: it is Tess/Ribbon/Roberta Hook wall hooks, Maggie Hook Rack, Majken Coat Rack, Archie Coat Rack, 2 Archie Rack Mirror and a single Rising Coat Stand - primary product type is wall hooks/racks, excluded. 'Coat Racks' (12) is a strict subset of that and is 100% wall hooks, excluded. ABSENCE OF OTHER FURNITURE TYPES IS EARNED: the full 146-product Furniture collection was enumerated and contains 61 distinct product names - there is no bed, bed frame, wardrobe, cabinet, sideboard, dresser, chest of drawers, TV/media unit or display cabinet anywhere in Broste's catalogue, so no such leaf is missing. OUTDOOR: /collections/outdoor-living has no sub-collections and is mixed - 21 of its 33 products are furniture (Eden Garden Table 4, Eden Chair 2, Eden Armchair 2, Eden Bench 2, Fiber Table 2, Fiber Side Table 1, Fiber Stool 2, Fiber Storage bench 1, Rillo Podium 5) and 12 are planters, floor vases and a cushion cover; most of the furniture is also cross-listed inside the Furniture tree. Emitted with its exact site count and a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than dropped or silently trimmed. B2B/login: none - this is a public consumer storefront, prices and counts render without sign-in, so no node is login-walled.
